title: Universal Life Insurance Loan Pricing Note: Rate on the Most Recent Loan Advance
content:
On an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy, the annual rate charged on the most recent loan advance, when loan interest is settled, follows the policy year of the settlement and the policy gain. The policy gain is the account value less the cost basis, both as shown on the policy record.

## Pricing rule

| Policy year of the settlement | Most recent loan advance compared with the policy gain | Rate charged on that advance |
|---|---|---|
| At or after the tier's preferred loan first policy year | No larger than the policy gain | Preferred loan charged rate, **3%** (0.03) |
| At or after the tier's preferred loan first policy year | Larger than the policy gain | Blended loan charged rate, **4%** (0.04) |
| Before the tier's preferred loan first policy year | Any | Standard loan charged rate, **5%** (0.05) |

The tier's preferred loan first policy year is policy year **11** on the Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL, Ashgrove Protection UL, Ashgrove Accumulation UL, Ashgrove Indexed UL Protect and Ashgrove Indexed UL Growth, and policy year **6** on the Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier. The preferred and standard rates are the same on every tier.

## Points of judgement

- **Equal amounts.** An advance exactly equal to the policy gain is "no larger than" it and is charged 3% in the preferred years.
- **Negative gain.** Where the cost basis exceeds the account value, the policy gain is below zero and any advance is larger than it.
- **Policy year.** The policy year is the policy year in which the settlement date falls.

## Hypothetical cases

| Tier and policy year | Account value | Cost basis | Policy gain | Most recent advance | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Accumulation UL, year 12 | $150000.00 | $110000.00 | $40000.00 | $25000.00 | 3% |
| Ashgrove Accumulation UL, year 12 | $150000.00 | $110000.00 | $40000.00 | $40000.00 | 3% |
| Ashgrove Accumulation UL, year 12 | $150000.00 | $110000.00 | $40000.00 | $45000.00 | 4% |
| Ashgrove Accumulation UL, year 9 | $150000.00 | $110000.00 | $40000.00 | $25000.00 | 5% |
| Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier, year 7 | $900000.00 | $950000.00 | minus $50000.00 | $10000.00 | 4% |
